subject: HealthGrid MAP — deployment mode decision & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara@healthgrid.com>, Procurement Team <pm+procurement@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: HealthGrid MAP — deployment mode decision & evaluation timeline

Hi Sara / HealthGrid procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) focused on the deployment-mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and a compact evaluation cadence so we can hit an Oct close if everything aligns. High-level asks from us:

- Your top success criteria (latency SLOs, data residency, key management) — add to the spreadsheet under "Decision Criteria".
- Risk/constraints for Private (on-prem/VPC) we should flag for legal & infra.
- Procurement window — when would a PO/SOW need to land to make Oct/Nov go-live?

Proposed evaluation path in the sheet:
1) Security review & SOC2 artifacts (week 1)
2) Short POC: Hosted performance baseline + Dedicated throughput check (week 2–3)
3) Private deployment feasibility (networking & KMS) + SOW redline (week 3–4)

I've attached Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx and SOC2-overview.pdf. Marissa and Karthik are looped in to cover commercial and infra questions. Can you confirm availability for a MAP sync next Tuesday?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
Attachment: SOC2-overview.pdf (pdf, 560KB)

From: Sara Lin <sara@healthgrid.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@healthgrid.com>, Procurement Team <pm+procurement@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HealthGrid MAP — deployment mode decision & evaluation timeline

Jordan — thanks for this and the clear plan. A few quick notes from our side:

- Security is the gating factor for us. Our preference today is Private (VPC or on-prem) because of PHI handling and our internal KMS policies, but we are open to evaluating Dedicated if we can ensure customer-managed keys or an HSM integration.
- Our compliance team will need the SOC2 artifact and a brief overview of your key management options (bring-your-own-key, HSM support). The SOC2 doc looks fine — could you also share a short note on KMS/cryptography?
- Procurement: our next budget cutoff is Oct 15. To make an Oct contractual close (sign by Oct 30) we need an agreed SOW and pricing by Oct 8 to run through approvals.

We'll review the MAP and add our acceptance criteria. Happy to meet next Tuesday (09/22) at 10am PT for the sync — Tom and I will join.

—Sara
Sara Lin
Head of ML Engineering, HealthGrid

Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx (internal note)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara@healthgrid.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HealthGrid MAP — deployment mode decision & evaluation timeline

Appreciate the clarity, Sara — confirmed for the 10am PT sync. Quick updates after prep with Marissa/Karthik/Serge:

- KMS note: attaching a 1-page KMS options brief (we'll surface BYOK and HSM paths, required networking ports, and latency implications).
- MAP update: I've added owner columns (Redwood: Jordan = AM, Marissa = Commercial lead, Karthik = Solutions/infra) and put tentative dates that align to your Oct 15 budget cutoff.
- POC approach suggestion: run a 5-day Hosted perf baseline (we'll stream to your test dataset) in parallel with a Dedicated throughput check (our Dedicated pool) so you can compare cost/latency. If Private is required, we'll start feasibility on network/topology while the POC runs — that prevents schedule slips.

I'll bring the updated MAP to the sync and record action items.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1_updated.xlsx (spreadsheet, 140KB); KMS_options_1pager.pdf (pdf, 60KB)

From: Procurement Team <pm+procurement@healthgrid.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Sara Lin <sara@healthgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HealthGrid MAP — procurement windows & SOW items

Jordan — procurement here. Quick checklist so we can route internally:

- Draft SOW with subscription term, pricing, and termination terms (we prefer an initial 12-month term with a 60-day cancellation window).
- Data residency and breach notification clauses (we may request specific language for PHI).
- Invoice and billing contact details; we require a U.S.-based vendor entity for faster processing.

If you can share a SOW draft by Oct 4 we can route for approvals ahead of your Oct 8 internal deadline. Please send the draft to pm+procurement@healthgrid.com and CC Sara.

Thanks,
HealthGrid Procurement

Looping legal and solutions so we can meet the Oct 4 SOW draft deadline:

Action items for Redwood:
- Marissa: finalize commercial term and draft SOW pricing (target send Oct 3).
- Karthik: validate Dedicated capacity availability and estimate cost delta vs Hosted for the POC (due Sep 30).
- Sergio: start Private feasibility checklist (network diagrams, estimated infra setup window, KMS integration notes) — due Oct 6 but flag any blockers immediately.
- Evelyn: legal to prepare PHI-specific clause language and review procurement checklist; expect a redline by Oct 6.

We should also prepare a short one-pager comparing expected latency/cost for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for the use case (Karthik + Sergio). Jordan, please keep the MAP updated with these dates and owners.

Marissa Cole

Thanks everyone — quick status and next steps:

- Marissa to send SOW draft by Oct 3 (on track).
- Karthik confirmed Dedicated capacity for an Oct 5–9 throughput check; estimated cost delta attached in the MAP.
- Sergio reported no irreversible blockers for Private but needs final network info from HealthGrid to confirm timing.
- Legal (Evelyn) will circulate PHI clause redlines by Oct 6.

Per HealthGrid procurement window, our milestone plan:
- Oct 8: internal decision on deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — goal for HealthGrid sign-off on preferred path.
- Oct 15: final pricing/SOW approvals in HealthGrid finance if decision is Hosted/Dedicated.
- Oct 30: target contract signature (falls within your Oct 15 budget run and approval cadence).
